# =========================
# Shared utilities
# =========================

def _to_nan_meps(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """
    MEPS common missing codes: -1/-7/-8/-9 etc.
    Convert all negative numeric values to NaN; non-numeric -> NaN.
    """
    s = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")
    return s.mask(s < 0, np.nan)

def _bool_to_meps_yesno(mask: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Boolean -> 1=Yes / 2=No, preserving NA (if mask has NA).
    """
    out = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=mask.index, dtype="Int64")
    out[mask == True] = 1
    out[mask == False] = 2
    return out

def _agg_yesno_from_flags(flags: pd.Series) -> "pd._libs.missing.NAType | int":
    """
    flags: Series of {1,2,NA}
    aggregation rule (person-level):
      - if any 1 => 1
      - else if any 2 => 2
      - else => NA
    """
    if (flags == 1).any():
        return 1
    if (flags == 2).any():
        return 2
    return pd.NA

# =========================
# LF feature engineering
# =========================

LF_COLS = [
    'DUID', 'DUPERSID', 'PANEL', 'AGE1X', 'SEX', 'RACETHNX', 'EDUCYR',
    'MARRY1X', 'MARRY2X', 'MARRY3X', 'FAMSY1', 'REGIONY1', 'POVCATY1',
    'RTHLTH1', 'RTHLTH2', 'RTHLTH3', 'MNHLTH1', 'MNHLTH2', 'MNHLTH3',
    'BMINDX3', 'EMPST1', 'EMPST2', 'EMPST3', 'PMDLAY2', 'MDDLAY2',
    'INSCOVY1', 'EVRUNIY1', 'TOTEXPY1', 'ERTOTY1', 'DIABDXY1',
    'ANGIDXY1', 'HIBPDXY1', 'BPMLDXY1', 'CHDDXY1', 'STRKDXY1', 'ASTHDXY1',
    'EMPHDXY1', 'CHOLDXY1', 'OHRTDXY1'
]

def process_lf_panel(df: pd.DataFrame, panel: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()

    # Panel 11 chronic vars alignment (if old names exist)
    if panel == 11:
        rename_map = {
            "DIABDX3": "DIABDXY1",
            "ANGIDX3": "ANGIDXY1",
            "HIBPDX3": "HIBPDXY1",
            "BPMLDX3": "BPMLDXY1",
            "CHDDX3":  "CHDDXY1",
            "STRKDX3": "STRKDXY1",
            "ASTHDX3": "ASTHDXY1",
            "EMPHDX3": "EMPHDXY1",
            "CHOLDX3": "CHOLDXY1",
            "OHRTDX3": "OHRTDXY1",
        }
        exist = {k: v for k, v in rename_map.items() if k in df.columns}
        if exist:
            df = df.rename(columns=exist)

    # Keep only LF columns if present
    keep_cols = [c for c in LF_COLS if c in df.columns]
    df = df[keep_cols].copy()

    # Missing-code cleaning for ALL cols (numeric-like)
    for c in df.columns:
        df[c] = _to_nan_meps(df[c])

    # Marriage: ever_married + marry_changed (1=Yes,2=No)
    marry_cols = [c for c in ["MARRY1X", "MARRY2X", "MARRY3X"] if c in df.columns]
    if marry_cols:
        marry_mat = df[marry_cols]
        any_valid = marry_mat.notna().any(axis=1)

        ever_mask = marry_mat.isin([1, 2, 3, 4]).any(axis=1)  # 5=never married
        df["ever_married"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        df.loc[any_valid, "ever_married"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(ever_mask[any_valid])

        nunique = marry_mat.apply(lambda r: r.dropna().nunique(), axis=1)
        changed_mask = nunique.gt(1)
        df["marry_changed"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        df.loc[any_valid, "marry_changed"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(changed_mask[any_valid])
    else:
        df["ever_married"] = pd.NA
        df["marry_changed"] = pd.NA


    # RTHLTH / MNHLTH mean
    rth_cols = [c for c in ["RTHLTH1", "RTHLTH2", "RTHLTH3"] if c in df.columns]
    if rth_cols:
        df["RTHLTH_mean"] = df[rth_cols].mean(axis=1)

    mnh_cols = [c for c in ["MNHLTH1", "MNHLTH2", "MNHLTH3"] if c in df.columns]
    if mnh_cols:
        df["MNHLTH_mean"] = df[mnh_cols].mean(axis=1)

    
    # EMPST: ever unemployed (EMPST==4) -> 1/2
    emp_cols = [c for c in ["EMPST1", "EMPST2", "EMPST3"] if c in df.columns]
    if emp_cols:
        emp_mat = df[emp_cols]
        any_valid_emp = emp_mat.notna().any(axis=1)
        ever_unemp_mask = emp_mat.eq(4).any(axis=1)

        df["ever_unemployed"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        df.loc[any_valid_emp, "ever_unemployed"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(ever_unemp_mask[any_valid_emp])
    else:
        df["ever_unemployed"] = pd.NA



    return df

# =========================
# MCF feature engineering
# =========================

MCF_COLS = ['DUID', 'PID', 'DUPERSID', 'PANEL', 'CONDRN', 'CRND1', 'CRND2', 'CRND3',
            'INJURY', 'ACCDENTY', 'CCCODEX']

# Panel -> Y1 year mapping (Panels 11-15 for 2006-2011)
PANEL_Y1_YEAR = {11: 2006, 12: 2007, 13: 2008, 14: 2009, 15: 2010, 16: 2011}

def process_mcf_panel(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Return person-level MCF features for Y1 (row-wise PANEL-aware):
      - INJURYY1: 1 Yes / 2 No (INJURY==1 AND CRND1-3 not all 0)
      - ACCDENTY1: 1 Yes / 2 No (ACCDENTY equals that row's PANEL Y1 year)
      - CANCERFLG: 1 Yes / 2 No (any CCCODEX in [11,45])
    All variables: negative codes -> NaN.
    """
    df = df.copy()

    # keep cols
    keep = [c for c in MCF_COLS if c in df.columns]
    df = df[keep].copy()

    # missing-code cleaning for ALL cols
    for c in df.columns:
        df[c] = _to_nan_meps(df[c])

    # group
    g = df.groupby("DUPERSID", dropna=False)
    panel_person = g["PANEL"].first()  # each person has exactly one PANEL

    # ---------- INJURYY1 ----------
    if all(c in df.columns for c in ["INJURY", "CRND1", "CRND2", "CRND3"]):
        cr = df[["CRND1", "CRND2", "CRND3"]]
        any_cr_info = cr.notna().any(axis=1)

        all0 = cr.fillna(0).eq(0).all(axis=1) & any_cr_info
        not_all0 = (~all0) & any_cr_info

        inj_yes_row = (df["INJURY"] == 1) & not_all0
        dec_avail = df["INJURY"].notna() & any_cr_info

        df["INJURYY1_rowflag"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        df.loc[dec_avail, "INJURYY1_rowflag"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(inj_yes_row[dec_avail])

        injury_person = g["INJURYY1_rowflag"].apply(_agg_yesno_from_flags).astype("Int64")
    else:
        injury_person = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Int64")

    # ---------- ACCDENTY1 (row-wise PANEL-aware) ----------
    if "PANEL" in df.columns and "ACCDENTY" in df.columns:
        y1_year_row = df["PANEL"].map(PANEL_Y1_YEAR)  # e.g., 11->2006, 12->2007...

        # decision-available: ACCDENTY observed + PANEL mapped
        dec_avail_acc = df["ACCDENTY"].notna() & y1_year_row.notna()

        acc_y1_row = df["ACCDENTY"].eq(y1_year_row.astype(float))

        df["ACCDENTY1_rowflag"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        df.loc[dec_avail_acc, "ACCDENTY1_rowflag"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(acc_y1_row[dec_avail_acc])

        acc_person = g["ACCDENTY1_rowflag"].apply(_agg_yesno_from_flags).astype("Int64")
    else:
        acc_person = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Int64")

    # ---------- CANCERFLG from CCCODEX ----------
    if "CCCODEX" in df.columns:
        dec_avail_cc = df["CCCODEX"].notna()
        cancer_row = df["CCCODEX"].between(11, 45, inclusive="both")

        df["CANCERFLG_rowflag"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        df.loc[dec_avail_cc, "CANCERFLG_rowflag"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(cancer_row[dec_avail_cc])

        cancer_person = g["CANCERFLG_rowflag"].apply(_agg_yesno_from_flags).astype("Int64")
    else:
        cancer_person = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Int64")

    # ---------- output person-level ----------
    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "DUPERSID": panel_person.index,
        "PANEL": panel_person.values,
        "INJURYY1": injury_person.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "ACCDENTY1": acc_person.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "CANCERFLG": cancer_person.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
    })

    return out

# ========================= 
# HISF processing
# ========================= 

HISF_COLS = ['DUID', 'PID', 'DUPERSID', 'PANEL', 'NUMNIGHX', 'EMERROOM', 'ANYOPER', 'IPBEGYR', 'IPCCC1X', 'IPCCC2X', 'IPCCC3X', 'IPCCC4X'] 

def process_hisf_panel(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Person-level HISF aggregates for Y1/Y2 (row-wise PANEL-aware).

    Output (by DUPERSID):
      - NUMNIGHTY1 / NUMNIGHTY2: sum(NUMNIGHX) for events in Y1 / Y2
      - NUMIPY1 / NUMIPY2: count(events) in Y1 / Y2
      - OPERY1 / OPERY2: count(events with ANYOPER==1) in Y1 / Y2
      - IPCANCERFLG: 1 Yes / 2 No if any IPCCC1-4 in [11,45] across events (NA if all missing)
    """
    df = df.copy()

    keep = [c for c in HISF_COLS if c in df.columns]
    df = df[keep].copy()

    # missing-code cleaning for ALL cols
    for c in df.columns:
        df[c] = _to_nan_meps(df[c])

    # basic requirements
    if "DUPERSID" not in df.columns or "PANEL" not in df.columns or "IPBEGYR" not in df.columns:
        g = df.groupby("DUPERSID", dropna=False) if "DUPERSID" in df.columns else None
        idx = g.size().index if g is not None else pd.Index([])
        return pd.DataFrame({
            "DUPERSID": idx,
            "PANEL": pd.NA,
            "NUMNIGHTY1": pd.NA,
            "NUMNIGHTY2": pd.NA,
            "NUMIPY1": pd.NA,
            "NUMIPY2": pd.NA,
            "OPERY1": pd.NA,
            "OPERY2": pd.NA,
            "IPCANCERFLG": pd.NA,
        })

    # ---------- Row-wise Y1 year by PANEL ----------
    y1_year_row = df["PANEL"].map(PANEL_Y1_YEAR)  # e.g., 11->2006, 12->2007 ...
    ipyr = df["IPBEGYR"]

    # Only decide Y1/Y2 when both PANEL is mappable and IPBEGYR exists
    valid_time = y1_year_row.notna() & ipyr.notna()

    is_y1 = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    is_y2 = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    is_y1.loc[valid_time] = ipyr.loc[valid_time].eq(y1_year_row.loc[valid_time].astype(float))
    is_y2.loc[valid_time] = ipyr.loc[valid_time].eq((y1_year_row.loc[valid_time] + 1).astype(float))

    # group
    g = df.groupby("DUPERSID", dropna=False)
    panel_person = g["PANEL"].first()  # each person unique panel in MEPS

    # ---------- NUMNIGHTY1 / NUMNIGHTY2 ----------
    if "NUMNIGHX" in df.columns:
        df["NUMNIGHX_Y1"] = df["NUMNIGHX"].where(is_y1, np.nan)
        df["NUMNIGHX_Y2"] = df["NUMNIGHX"].where(is_y2, np.nan)

        numnight = g[["NUMNIGHX_Y1", "NUMNIGHX_Y2"]].sum(min_count=1)
        NUMNIGHTY1 = numnight["NUMNIGHX_Y1"].astype("Float64")
        NUMNIGHTY2 = numnight["NUMNIGHX_Y2"].astype("Float64")
    else:
        NUMNIGHTY1 = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Float64")
        NUMNIGHTY2 = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Float64")

    # ---------- NUMIPY1 / NUMIPY2 (event counts) ----------
    tmp_counts = df.assign(
        _is_y1=is_y1.astype("Int64"),
        _is_y2=is_y2.astype("Int64")
    ).groupby("DUPERSID", dropna=False)[["_is_y1", "_is_y2"]].sum()

    NUMIPY1 = tmp_counts["_is_y1"].astype("Int64")
    NUMIPY2 = tmp_counts["_is_y2"].astype("Int64")

    # ---------- OPERY1 / OPERY2 (surgery event counts) ----------
    if "ANYOPER" in df.columns:
        oper_y1 = (is_y1 & (df["ANYOPER"] == 1)).astype("Int64")
        oper_y2 = (is_y2 & (df["ANYOPER"] == 1)).astype("Int64")

        oper = df.assign(_oper_y1=oper_y1, _oper_y2=oper_y2) \
                 .groupby("DUPERSID", dropna=False)[["_oper_y1", "_oper_y2"]].sum()

        OPERY1 = oper["_oper_y1"].astype("Int64")
        OPERY2 = oper["_oper_y2"].astype("Int64")
    else:
        OPERY1 = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Int64")
        OPERY2 = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Int64")

    # ---------- IPCANCERFLG (1/2) from IPCCC1X-4X ----------
    ccc_cols = [c for c in ["IPCCC1X", "IPCCC2X", "IPCCC3X", "IPCCC4X"] if c in df.columns]
    if ccc_cols:
        ccc = df[ccc_cols]
        any_ccc_info = ccc.notna().any(axis=1)
        cancer_event = ccc.apply(lambda r: r.dropna().between(11, 45, inclusive="both").any(), axis=1)

        rowflag = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
        rowflag.loc[any_ccc_info] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(cancer_event.loc[any_ccc_info])

        IPCANCERFLG = rowflag.groupby(df["DUPERSID"], dropna=False).apply(_agg_yesno_from_flags).astype("Int64")
    else:
        IPCANCERFLG = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=panel_person.index, dtype="Int64")

    # ---------- output ----------
    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "DUPERSID": panel_person.index,
        "PANEL": panel_person.values,
        "NUMNIGHTY1": NUMNIGHTY1.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "NUMNIGHTY2": NUMNIGHTY2.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "NUMIPY1": NUMIPY1.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "NUMIPY2": NUMIPY2.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "OPERY1": OPERY1.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "OPERY2": OPERY2.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
        "IPCANCERFLG": IPCANCERFLG.reindex(panel_person.index).values,
    })

    return out

# Process duplicates in MCF (Some individuals have records in 2 MCF files)

def merge_yesno(series: pd.Series):
    s = series.dropna()
    if (s == 1).any():
        return 1
    if (s == 2).any():
        return 2
    return pd.NA

for c in ["INJURYY1", "ACCDENTY1", "CANCERFLG"]:
    if c in df_MCF_p.columns:
        df_MCF_p[c] = df_MCF_p[c].astype("Int64")

df_MCF_p = (
    df_MCF_p
      .groupby("DUPERSID", as_index=False, dropna=False)
      .agg(
          PANEL=("PANEL", "first"),
          INJURYY1=("INJURYY1", merge_yesno),
          ACCDENTY1=("ACCDENTY1", merge_yesno),
          CANCERFLG=("CANCERFLG", merge_yesno),
      )
)

# Merge MCF and HISF into LF on DUPERSID


# Make sure DUPERSID is unique in each file
assert not df_MCF_p.duplicated(subset=["DUPERSID"]).any(), "MCF key not unique!"
assert not df_HISF_p.duplicated(subset=["DUPERSID"]).any(), "HISF key not unique!"
assert not df_LF_p.duplicated(subset=["DUPERSID"]).any(), "LF key not unique!"

# Merge, left join to LF
df_master = (
    df_LF_p
      .merge(df_MCF_p, on=["DUPERSID","PANEL"], how="left", suffixes=("", "_MCF"))
      .merge(df_HISF_p, on=["DUPERSID","PANEL"], how="left", suffixes=("", "_HISF"))
)

def missing_check(df):
    missing_summary = pd.DataFrame({
        "missing_count": df.isna().sum(),
        "missing_rate": df.isna().mean() * 100,
        "dtype": df.dtypes.astype(str),
        "non_missing_count": df.notna().sum()
    }).sort_values(by=["missing_rate", "missing_count"], ascending=False)
    missing_summary["missing_rate"] = missing_summary["missing_rate"].round(2)
    print("=== Missing Value Summary (by column) ===")
    print(missing_summary)

    overall_missing_cells = int(df.isna().sum().sum())
    overall_cells = int(df.size)
    print("\n=== Overall Missing Cells ===")
    print("Missing cells:", overall_missing_cells)
    print("Total cells:", overall_cells)
    print("Overall missing rate (%):", round(overall_missing_cells / overall_cells * 100, 2))

missing_check(df)

# Missing distribution check

# find columns with missing
cols_to_check = df.columns[df.isna().any()].tolist()
print("Columns with missing:", len(cols_to_check))
print(cols_to_check)

# age groups
age_bins = [17, 34, 49, 64, 200]
age_labels = ["18-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+"]
df["AGE_BIN"] = pd.cut(df["AGE1X"], bins=age_bins, labels=age_labels, right=True, include_lowest=True)

group_keys = ["PANEL", "AGE_BIN", "SEX", "RACETHNX"]  # set demension keys for grouping

# calculate missing rate in each group separately
records = []
grp = df.groupby(group_keys, dropna=False)

for col in cols_to_check:
    miss_rate = grp[col].apply(lambda s: s.isna().mean())
    n = grp[col].size()
    tmp = miss_rate.reset_index(name="missing_rate")
    tmp["n_in_group"] = n.values
    tmp["column"] = col
    tmp["missing_count"] = (tmp["missing_rate"] * tmp["n_in_group"]).round().astype(int)
    records.append(tmp)

missing_by_group = pd.concat(records, ignore_index=True)

# ignore small groups(n < 200)
min_n = 200
missing_by_group_filtered = missing_by_group[missing_by_group["n_in_group"] >= min_n].copy()

# show top-k missing groups per column
topk = 10 # set top-k
for col in cols_to_check:
    sub = missing_by_group_filtered[missing_by_group_filtered["column"] == col] \
        .sort_values(["missing_rate", "missing_count"], ascending=False) \
        .head(topk)
    if len(sub) == 0:
        continue
    print(f"\n=== Top {topk} missing groups for: {col} ===")
    print(sub.to_string(index=False))

# missing indicators
for c in cols_to_check:
    df[f"{c}_missing"] = df[c].isna().astype(int)

# helper: groupwise fill (mode), with fallback
def fill_groupwise(series, group_df, method="mode"):
    s = series.copy()
    if method == "median":
        gstat = group_df.transform(lambda x: x.median())
        fallback = s.median()
    else:
        def _mode(x):
            m = x.mode(dropna=True)
            return m.iloc[0] if len(m) else np.nan
        gstat = group_df.transform(_mode)
        m = s.mode(dropna=True)
        fallback = m.iloc[0] if len(m) else np.nan

    s = s.fillna(gstat)
    s = s.fillna(fallback)
    return s

# BMINDX3: sex x agebin median
if "BMINDX3" in cols_to_check:
    df["BMINDX3"] = fill_groupwise(df["BMINDX3"], df.groupby(["SEX","AGE_BIN"])["BMINDX3"], method="median")

# FAMSY1: agebin x racethnx median
if "FAMSY1" in cols_to_check:
    df["FAMSY1"] = fill_groupwise(df["FAMSY1"], df.groupby(["AGE_BIN","RACETHNX"])["FAMSY1"], method="median")

# REGIONY1: panel mode
if "REGIONY1" in cols_to_check:
    df["REGIONY1"] = fill_groupwise(df["REGIONY1"], df.groupby(["PANEL"])["REGIONY1"], method="mode")

# delay vars: panel x agebin mode
for c in ["PMDLAY2", "MDDLAY2"]:
    if c in cols_to_check:
        df[c] = fill_groupwise(df[c], df.groupby(["PANEL","AGE_BIN"])[c], method="mode")

# Recalculate aggregates

# Marriage: ever_married + marry_changed (1=Yes,2=No)
marry_cols = [c for c in ["MARRY1X", "MARRY2X", "MARRY3X"] if c in df.columns]
if marry_cols:
    marry_mat = df[marry_cols]
    any_valid = marry_mat.notna().any(axis=1)

    ever_mask = marry_mat.isin([1, 2, 3, 4]).any(axis=1)  # 5=never married
    df["ever_married"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
    df.loc[any_valid, "ever_married"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(ever_mask[any_valid])

    nunique = marry_mat.apply(lambda r: r.dropna().nunique(), axis=1)
    changed_mask = nunique.gt(1)
    df["marry_changed"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
    df.loc[any_valid, "marry_changed"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(changed_mask[any_valid])
else:
    df["ever_married"] = pd.NA
    df["marry_changed"] = pd.NA


# RTHLTH / MNHLTH mean
rth_cols = [c for c in ["RTHLTH1", "RTHLTH2", "RTHLTH3"] if c in df.columns]
if rth_cols:
    df["RTHLTH_mean"] = df[rth_cols].mean(axis=1)

mnh_cols = [c for c in ["MNHLTH1", "MNHLTH2", "MNHLTH3"] if c in df.columns]
if mnh_cols:
    df["MNHLTH_mean"] = df[mnh_cols].mean(axis=1)

    
# EMPST: ever unemployed (EMPST==4) -> 1/2
emp_cols = [c for c in ["EMPST1", "EMPST2", "EMPST3"] if c in df.columns]
if emp_cols:
    emp_mat = df[emp_cols]
    any_valid_emp = emp_mat.notna().any(axis=1)
    ever_unemp_mask = emp_mat.eq(4).any(axis=1)

    df["ever_unemployed"] = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="Int64")
    df.loc[any_valid_emp, "ever_unemployed"] = _bool_to_meps_yesno(ever_unemp_mask[any_valid_emp])
else:
    df["ever_unemployed"] = pd.NA

# Outlier processing

def winsorize_upper_float(series: pd.Series, upper_q=0.99):
    s = series.astype("Float64") 
    cap = float(s.quantile(upper_q))
    return s.clip(upper=cap), cap

# TOTEXPY1: upper winsorize, log1p transform

if "TOTEXPY1" not in df.columns:
    print(f"WARNING: TOTEXPY1 not found, skip.")


df["TOTEXPY1"], cap = winsorize_upper_float(df["TOTEXPY1"], upper_q=0.995)
df[f"{"TOTEXPY1"}_log1p"] = np.log1p(df["TOTEXPY1"])

print(f"TOTEXPY1: dtype -> {df['TOTEXPY1'].dtype}, capped at p995={cap:.2f}")

# BMINDX3: keep range 10-80, drop outliers
if "BMINDX3" in df.columns:
    df["BMINDX3"] = df["BMINDX3"].astype("Float64")

    bmi_low, bmi_high = 10, 80
    outliers = ~df["BMINDX3"].between(bmi_low, bmi_high)
    print(f"BMINDX3: dtype -> {df['BMINDX3'].dtype}, outliers (set to NA) count: {outliers.sum()}")
    df.loc[outliers, "BMINDX3"] = pd.NA

# NUMNIGHTY1, NUMNIGHTY2: upper winsorize at 995th percentile
for col in ["NUMNIGHTY1", "NUMNIGHTY2"]:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col], cap = winsorize_upper_float(df[col], upper_q=0.995)
        print(f"{col}: dtype -> {df[col].dtype}, capped at p995={cap:.2f}")

# 4) LOS distribution by age groups
age_bins = [17, 34, 49, 64, 200]
age_labels = ["18-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+"]

df["AGE_BIN"] = pd.cut(
    df["AGE1X"],
    bins=age_bins,
    labels=age_labels,
    include_lowest=True
)

los_col = "NUMNIGHTY2"

df = df.loc[df[los_col] > 0]

data = [df.loc[df["AGE_BIN"] == lab, los_col].astype(float).values for lab in age_labels]

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.boxplot(data, labels=age_labels, showfliers=True)  
plt.xlabel("Age Group")
plt.ylabel("LOS (NUMNIGHTY2) - nights")
plt.title("LOS Distribution by Age Group(0 LOS excluded)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# summary stat
summary = df.groupby("AGE_BIN")[los_col].agg(
    n="count",
    median="median",
    mean="mean",
    p75=lambda x: x.quantile(0.75),
    p95=lambda x: x.quantile(0.95),
    max="max"
).reset_index()
print(summary)
